comment: In-app Credits for downloadable sound content (licensing report section 6). Every shipped sample must belong to a GREEN record here; tools/content accepts CC0-1.0, CC-BY-3.0 and CC-BY-4.0 only (D-193, D-391). A CC BY item carries the attribution line the licence asks for, the licence URL and the modifications made.
